title: The Wars of the Jews; or, The History of the Destruction of Jerusalem (tr. William Whiston)
author: Flavius Josephus
summary: Eyewitness history of the Jewish revolt and the Roman siege and destruction of Jerusalem and the temple (AD 66-70); the main source for preterist correlations with Revelation 8-11.

title: Revelation: A New Translation with Introduction and Commentary (Anchor Yale Bible 38A)
author: Craig R. Koester
summary: Major critical commentary attentive to the social, economic and religious setting of Roman Asia and to Jewish sources including the Dead Sea Scrolls.
